summary: Resolve a user-supplied physical board to its exact Zephyr board target and fitted MCU or SoC using the installed west board catalog.
verification: Confirm the marketing name, vendor, fitted device, revision, and qualifiers; compare with the current online board listing without overriding local installed data.
stop_conditions: Request the intended target when multiple SoCs, CPU clusters, or variants remain possible.
Stop when the physical board, exact target, or fitted device remains ambiguous.

rules.delta: Zephyr target, fitted device, revision, qualifier, or board match from a probe, directory name, or fuzzy search alone.
Keep the installed Zephyr board catalog authoritative for its version; do not introduce CMSIS-pack … assumptions.

extracted.title: Query the installed Zephyr board catalog with west
extracted.body:
From the verified Zephyr workspace, run the venv-local `west boards` command. Treat this version-matched catalog, generated from the installed `board.yml` files, as authoritative for the installed Zephyr version.

Find candidates with `west boards --fuzzy-match "<candidate>"`. Normalize punctuation and capitalization only for searching; do not confirm a fuzzy result without checking its metadata.

For each candidate, run:

west boards --board <board-name> --cmakeformat "{NAME}|{VENDOR}|{SOCS}|{QUALIFIERS}|{REVISION_DEFAULT}|{REVISIONS}|{DIR}"
